title: VPN authentication troubleshooting
content: Confirm the corporate VPN gateway is reachable. Check whether the user recently changed a password and whether MFA completes. Ask the user to sign out and establish a fresh session. Collect client and authentication logs for identity support. Never reset credentials or disable MFA automatically.

title: Expired password and account lockout
content: Confirm account state through the approved identity status lookup. If locked or expired, route to Identity Support. Credential resets and MFA changes require an authorized human. Preserve timestamps and error codes in work notes.

title: Laptop thermal and fan troubleshooting
content: Record device model, ambient conditions, workload, and whether vents are obstructed. Collect approved diagnostic logs and check vendor health status. Do not open hardware or change firmware settings remotely. Escalate persistent thermal warnings to Endpoint Support.

title: Outlook desktop startup failure
content: Check Microsoft 365 service health and collect the application error code. A profile restart or cache repair may be offered only after user approval. Preserve unsent mail concerns and escalate repeated crashes with diagnostic logs to Messaging Support.

title: Database connection timeout triage
content: Capture the affected database, application, time range, and error code. Check read-only service health and connection metrics. Do not restart databases or kill sessions automatically. Page Database Operations for widespread or business-critical impact.

title: DNS resolution and connectivity checks
content: Perform an allowlisted DNS lookup and basic reachability check for the reported hostname. Compare results against the approved resolver. Save returned status and timestamp. Do not edit DNS records or firewall rules; route inconsistent or widespread failures to Network Operations.

title: Shared drive access denied
content: Confirm the exact share path, affected users, and when access last worked. Verify group membership through the approved read-only directory lookup. Access grants and privilege changes require manager approval and human execution by Identity Support.

title: Security incident containment and escalation
content: Treat suspected compromise as high sensitivity. Preserve evidence and timestamps, avoid interacting with suspicious artifacts, and immediately route to Security Operations. Do not disable accounts, isolate endpoints, or delete files without approved incident response authority.

title: Printer connectivity checks
content: Confirm printer name, location, affected users, and displayed error. Read-only status and connectivity checks are safe. Clearing queues or restarting shared print services requires approval from Endpoint Support.

title: Cloud service availability triage
content: Check the published provider status and approved internal service dashboard. Capture region, start time, and number of affected users. Widespread or customer-facing impact is escalated to Platform SRE; do not change production configuration.
